display.purpose: Oversized tiled hero wall text on the landing page only.

headline.purpose: Card titles, ticket-type name, section titles.

label.purpose: Ticker, countdown, stat, and badge labels — always uppercase.

shadows.name: sticker-offset
shadows.purpose: Hard offset shadow on hero collage stickers (ribbon element).

motion.name: ticker-scroll

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default/safe action — white fill, black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:block; width:100%; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; padding:14px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:none; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; background:#ffffff; color:#000000; transition:opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FD5400; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Paid/upsell action — orange fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display:block; width:100%; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; padding:14px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:none; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; background:#FD5400; color:#ffffff; transition:opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { opacity:0.9; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/in-row action — transparent with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #232323; background:transparent; color:#cccccc; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#FD5400; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Generic content card — flat, one step off black, hairline border.
components.html:
Lista gratis
Antes de las 11pm
Anótate y recibe tu QR al instante.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#0a0a0a; border:1px solid #232323; border-radius:14px; padding:28px 24px; color:#ffffff; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; } .ds-card-tag { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1.5px; color:#FD5400; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:10px; font-weight:700; } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:20px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-card-note { font-size:13px; color:#999999; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Ticket Card
components.description: The generated ticket — signature component, QR always on a white tile.
components.html:
Entrada pagada · S/45
Nombre Apellido
QR
PDS-A1B2C3
Muestra este código en la puerta.
components.css: .ds-ticket { background:#0a0a0a; border:1px solid #FD540055; border-radius:16px; padding:30px; text-align:center; color:#ffffff; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(253,84,0,0.10); } .ds-ticket-type { font-size:11px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#FD5400; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:700; } .ds-ticket-name { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:18px; } .ds-ticket-qr { background:#ffffff; color:#000; width:180px; height:180px; margin:0 auto; border-radius:10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:monospace; } .ds-ticket-id { font-family:monospace; font-size:12px; color:#888888; letter-spacing:1px; margin:16px 0; } .ds-ticket-note { font-size:12px; color:#999999; line-height:1.6; border-top:1px solid #232323; padding-top:16px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text/email/date field with label above, orange focus border.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; font-size:12px; color:#999999; margin-bottom:6px; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { width:100%; background:#000000; border:1px solid #232323; color:#ffffff; padding:12px; border-radius:7px; font-size:14px; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#FD5400; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped ticket-state indicator, semantic palette separate from brand colors.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:12px; font-size:11px; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; } .ds-badge-free { background:#1a2a3a; color:#7fbfe0; } .ds-badge-paid { background:#2a1a3a; color:#c07fe0; } .ds-badge-in { background:#0a2a12; color:#7fe0a0; } .ds-badge-out { background:#2a2a2a; color:#999999; } .ds-badge-void { background:#2a0a0a; color:#e07f7f; }

components.name: Ticker Marquee
components.description: Auto-scrolling brand/genre band; doubles as header and section divider.
components.css: .ds-ticker { overflow:hidden; background:#FFC700; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:3px solid #000000; } .ds-ticker-track { display:flex; white-space:nowrap; width:max-content; animation:ds-scroll-left 20s linear infinite; } .ds-ticker span { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:3px; padding:0 24px; color:#000000; } @keyframes ds-scroll-left { from { transform:translateX(0); } to { transform:translateX(-50%); } }

narrative.overview:
Paradisio's landing page is a black wall papered over in oversized, stroked-outline type and screen-printed stickers — the visual grammar of a photocopied rave flyer stapled to a Barranco lamppost, not a polished nightlife brand deck. Three inks do all the work on that wall: fire orange, acid yellow, and alarm red, laid down flat and hard-edged against pure black, the way spray paint and marker sit on a poster rather than the way a gradient sits on a screen. Nothing here is soft, pastel, or "elegant nightlife" — it commits fully to maximalist, high-contrast collage, and it explicitly avoids the white-sand, sun-bleached Ibiza-flyer cliché in favor of something louder, blacker, and more concrete.

Once a visitor commits — buying a ticket, checking in at the door, running the admin panel — the system deliberately quiets down. Checkout, the ticket picker, staff check-in, and the admin dashboard all drop to a single accent (orange) on flat dark cards with hairline borders: legible, calm, and fast to scan under bad lighting at 1am. The loud collage world and the quiet operational world share one type system and one accent color, so the app never feels like two products, but they never bleed into each other stylistically either.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black canvas, everywhere, with color used as ink, not as tint or gradient.
Oversized stroked-outline Orbitron type as the dominant landing-page motif.
Exactly one accent color (orange) survives past the hero; yellow and red are hero-only.
Hard, offset "sticker" shadows on the collage; no shadows at all on operational screens except one ambient accent glow.
Skewed geometry (ticker, countdown chips, stripe band) on the hero; upright, calm geometry everywhere else.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Every screen past the landing hero (checkout, ticket picker, staff, admin) uses exactly one accent color — orange. Yellow and red are reserved for the collage and never appear in the operational UI.

rules.name: The All-Caps Shout Rule
rules.body: Orbitron only ever appears uppercase — it is never used in sentence case, and it is never used for body copy.

rules.name: The Sticker Shadow Rule
rules.body: Any shadow on the hero collage is a hard, zero-blur offset — never a soft blur. It reads as paper on paper, not glass floating.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent color (orange #FD5400) on every Operate screen; reserve yellow and red for the landing hero only.
Do give the QR code a white background tile even on fully dark screens — scanner legibility overrides theme consistency.
Do use Orbitron only in uppercase, and only for shouted, structural, or numeric content — never for body copy.
Do keep cards flat (hairline border only) outside the hero; reserve the ambient glow shadow for the single featured/accent card on a screen.
donts: Don't introduce a fourth brand hue; the palette is fixed to orange / yellow / red / black / white.
Don't apply the hero's hard sticker shadows or skewed geometry to Operate screens — those stay upright, calm, and shadow-free.
Don't confuse the ticket-status badge colors (blue/purple/green/gray/red-tinted) with the three brand accents — they are a separate semantic palette.
Don't give a collage/sticker element a soft blurred shadow — it's a hard offset or nothing.
